glance: Treasury Secretary Bessent wants answers from Nvidia's board within 10 days as the SEC accounting probe and filing delay weigh on the chipmaker.
A researcher's bait test found AI providers leaking prompts: planted fake AWS keys were reused tens of thousands of times.
Russia struck an apartment block in Dymer near Kyiv overnight; Zelensky says 14 people are unaccounted for.
Max Verstappen won a chaotic Las Vegas Grand Prix; Lando Norris grabbed second on the final lap.
Bitcoin trades near $59,000 Sunday after briefly sinking to about $55,600 Saturday, its lowest in two years.

tech.headline: Nvidia probe widens as Washington demands answers within 10 days
tech.summary: After reports that the SEC is examining Nvidia's accounting and disclosures, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said he wants answers from the board and outside counsel within roughly 10 days. Nvidia has delayed its quarterly 10-Q filing and cited an independent board committee review, while the FT reports about half of 2025 revenue ran through its Singapore unit. The stock lost nearly $900 billion in value last week, its worst week since 2008.

tech.headline: Bait test shows AI services leaking users' prompts
tech.summary: Security researcher HD Moore sent nearly 2 million prompts containing planted fake secrets to AI providers and found at least three providers breached, resellers logging prompts and some ignoring zero-retention settings. A couple hundred bait AWS keys were later tried tens of thousands of times by attackers. It is a warning against pasting credentials or sensitive data into chatbots.
tech.source: Ars Technica via Sam on AI

tech.headline: Bell Canada says an AI-driven attacker stole enterprise customer data
tech.summary: Bell Canada disclosed a Nov. 17 breach by what it described as an agentic, AI-assisted attacker that took enterprise customer records, including circuit ordering and provisioning data. It joins a string of incidents this month in which attackers used AI agents to find and exploit flaws, including Amazon's report on China-linked hackers.

tech.headline: Signal blocks screenshots to keep AI assistants out of chats
tech.summary: Signal now restricts screenshots on iOS 27 and Android so built-in assistants like Siri and Gemini can't read conversations off the screen. Signal president Meredith Whittaker acknowledged the fix is incomplete.
tech.source: The Verge via Sam on AI

tech.headline: Google rolls out AI-first homepage without a search button
tech.summary: Google began rolling out a redesigned homepage built around its AI Mode, adding a chat-history sidebar and dropping the familiar Search button. It is one of the most visible changes to Google's front page in decades as the company pushes users toward conversational search.

tech.headline: METR: AI agents now match skilled humans on coding tasks
tech.summary: Evaluation group METR's latest update finds frontier agents match or beat skilled humans on coding and optimization work but still trail experts on judgment-heavy tasks. The length of tasks AI can complete is doubling roughly every 3.6 months. Separately, OpenAI said new safeguards cut attempts to extract its models' hidden reasoning from 54% success to 0.2% in internal tests.

other.headline: Russian strike hits apartment block near Kyiv; 14 unaccounted for
other.summary: An overnight attack destroyed a section of a five-story building in Dymer, north of Kyiv, and President Zelensky said 14 people may be trapped under the rubble. Ukraine's air force said Russia launched 186 drones, 161 of which were downed or jammed. Separately, Britain agreed to fund production of Ukrainian strike drones in the UK.
other.source: Kyiv Independent via Ukraine desk note

other.headline: NATO's eastern flank reports airspace scares
other.summary: Poland's top operational commander said a NATO Swedish Gripen pilot was cleared to shoot down a suspected Russian cruise missile over Poland on Nov. 20 but couldn't identify it in bad weather. Moldova reported a Russian drone crossing its airspace twice, and Finland is investigating a suspected helicopter incursion.
other.source: Kyiv Independent via Ukraine desk note

other.headline: Trump orders contractors to loop in White House on congressional requests
other.summary: President Trump issued an executive order directing federal contractors to coordinate with the White House when congressional committees request information from them. The move touches on how much direct access Congress has to companies doing government work.

other.headline: Bitcoin steadies near $59,000 after two-year low
other.summary: Bitcoin hovered around $58,900 Sunday after dropping to about $55,600 Saturday, leaving it more than 50% below its October 2025 peak. Spot Bitcoin ETFs have seen about $2.35 billion in recent outflows as the AI-led stock selloff spilled into crypto.

other.headline: Verstappen wins chaotic Las Vegas Grand Prix
other.summary: Max Verstappen won Saturday night's race on the Strip as Lando Norris passed Kimi Antonelli for second on the final lap. George Russell crashed out and the two Ferraris collided, adding to a messy night for Mercedes and Ferrari.
